jo_cs: Quick status check for KEYSTONE private/VPC onboarding — week0 health + a couple of asks from their security team (retention & rotation).

jo_cs: Customer asks: 1) 13-month S3 audit log retention 2) 90-day CMK rotation managed by us 3) allow CIDR 10.20.40.0/22 to reach our syslog collector over TCP/6514 temporarily.

lee_net: For peering inbound, minimal changes: add route 10.20.40.0/22 -> pcx-0f1e2d, SG allow tcp 6514 from 10.20.40.0/22. Need to update NACLs if present. Will write a short runbook.

jo_cs: Are there any compliance caveats with opening that CIDR inbound?

lee_net: Inbound increases attack surface; require flow logs and tag the peering connection. Recommend sampling increase during onboarding.

omar_kms: KMS note: keystone-cmk rotation=false; audit shows last_rotate=2024-09-10. Our rotation service supports 30/60/365 by default. 90-day would be a new cadence (est ~3 dev-days + testing).

tracey_am: Renewal risk: customer said rotation requirement is in their compliance spec; willing to pay one-time engineering fee. Flagging for AMs.

jo_cs: Options to present: A) we build 90-day rotation (quoted) B) customer manages rotation in their account and we accept rotated alias (faster). Which is recommended operationally?

omar_kms: Operationally B is fastest. If we own rotation, we need pre-signed alias swap & grants to avoid outages during rotation. Will draft steps.

ops-bot: KMS status query: keystone-cmk rotation=false | created=2023-10-01 | policy=restricted-prod

lee_net: Test plan: once route/SG staged, ask their infra to push one TLS-wrapped syslog line to our test endpoint to validate route + SG + TLS.

jo_cs: Docs feedback: they want a single-page runbook with role JSON, KMS alias swap steps, and a short connectivity checklist. I'll add to docs backlog and draft it.

tracey_am: Action items:
- @lee_net: connectivity runbook + risk note (ETA 24h)
- @omar_kms: KMS options doc + eng estimate for 90-day rotation (ETA 48h)
- @jo_cs: open commercial deviation and draft quote for 90-day work + retention premium (ETA tomorrow)
- @jo_cs: confirm CIDR and port with customer's infra (ETA today)

jo_cs: Closing loop for now. If anything blocks, ping me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
